_comment: Golden fixtures for the offline SOS SMS contract.
The message body is composed on the resident's phone in TypeScript
device has no data, and parsed on the server in Python
(apps/api/apps/sms/parsing.py). Nothing enforces that those two stay in
step except this file: the node test asserts the renderer produces these
exact strings, and the Django test asserts the parser reads these exact
strings back into these exact fields.
If you change the wording on either side, this file must change too - and
both test suites will tell you if only one side was updated.
